method.title: 干净参考图与实际编码合成不一致
method.trigger: 该源德语合成中，干净图片存在但标签修补区域透明度为零。
method.action: 核对实际补丁alpha，并对照源图、底片和编码译片；不以干净输入证明成片去字。
method.failure_signature: 零alpha使英文仍在编码成片中；修正后所审样本的英德叠字消失。
limitations: 记录中的对照叙述位于hypothesis，须复核打包媒体。

method.next_counterexample_test: 独立检查相同位置的源、底片、补丁alpha和编码前后帧。

record.hypothesis: Single-source German observation: an ImageGen clean photograph did not remove English in the encoded composite when the pasted label regions had zero alpha. Correcting the actual patch alpha and checking source/base/encoded-target samples removed the observed English/German overlap. The revised sample preserves people and call icons with minor reconstructed lace/hair and font-weight differences. A clean input image alone does not establish clean encoded output.
limitations: One source and one corrected German comparison, not independent cross-source validation.
No full normal-speed playback or human listening; internal quality remains revise and the delivered video is best_available.
This observation does not authorize solid panels, omission of original text removal, or automatic quality approval.
